year.description: the `year` component of the extracted or computed date.

month.description: the `month` component of the extracted or computed date.

day.description: the `day` component of the extracted or computed date.

hour.description: the `hour` component of the extracted or computed time (in 24-hour format).

minute.description: the `minute` component of the extracted or computed time.

second.description: the `second` component of the extracted or computed time.

rationale.description: step-by-step details of how you produced your output.
